note: SASSA has confirmed the September 2026 permanent grant dates and the SRD R370 payment dates of 23 and 25 September 2026. The fourth payment day for grants under review is not yet confirmed.

governance.source: SASSA official September 2026 SRD payment dates announcement
governance.notes: Permanent grant dates and the SRD R370 payment dates of 23 and 25 September 2026 are confirmed by SASSA. Beneficiaries are paid in a batch on either 23 or 25 September depending on their 'Pay Day' date on the official SRD portal, not on both dates. The fourth payment day for grants under review remains TBC and is shown as projected.
